_description: Sprint 10b (ADR-0033), plan §A.1/§C.1, §E.9 item 2. Regression (real, must stay unchanged) + the one approved new positive (constructed — no real staging question motivated it; flagged as anticipatory, not corrective). Metric: every regression case routes identically (source=deterministic_salary*, never llm); the new positive now matches. Harness: Sprint10bInvariantTest.php — test_every_real_salary_question_still_routes_deterministically_to_salary / test_the_new_colloquial_salary_pattern_matches_deterministically. `correction01_statutory_escalation` below (Sprint10bCorrection01Test.php) pins the downstream ESCALATION OUTCOME across both the no-tables and with-tables employee profiles — a second, distinct thing from this file's other sections, which only pin pattern MATCHING.

regression_real.question: ¿Cuál es mi salario base mensual y mi salario anual según las tablas salariales vigentes?
¿Cuánto cobro este mes según mi tabla salarial?

regression_pattern_unit_cases.question: ¿cuándo me pagan la paga extra de verano?
no me ha llegado la nómina de este mes
¿me paga el gimnasio la empresa?
regression_pattern_unit_cases.note: the pattern's own doc-comment worked example — deliberately NOT salary (a benefit question, not a pay-figure question).

new_positive_constructed.question: ¿Cuánto es el plus de transporte este mes?
new_positive_constructed.note: D1's one approved addition — a plus/complemento is a salary-table line item, same tier as 'paga extra'. No real staging question motivated this.

new_positive_constructed.question: ¿tengo derecho a pluses de transporte y nocturnidad?

new_positive_real_d1bis.question: ¿Cuál es el SMI este año?
new_positive_real_d1bis.note: D1-bis (build-authorization amendment, post-review). This is the exact question that was the CP-3 staging gold-eval's single miss (expected escalate_salary, got escalate_off_domain) — re-diagnosed as a genuine lexicon gap (the acronym 'SMI' never spells out 'salario'), not just pre-existing router flap. Now routes deterministically via the new /\bSMI\b/iu pattern; expected downstream outcome for the fixture employee with no salary table is a STABLE escalate_salary/salary_coverage_gap, never off_domain again — see review.md §3.2 for the re-run.

new_positive_real_d1bis.question: ¿ha subido el salario mínimo interprofesional este año?
new_positive_real_d1bis.note: spelled-out variant of the same concept. Already covered by the pre-existing bare 'salario' pattern (matches the substring 'salario' regardless of what follows); the new explicit /\bsalario\s+m[ií]nimo(\s+interprofesional)?\b/iu pattern is redundant here by design (added for clarity of intent, not because it is load-bearing) — this row proves the redundancy holds, not a new capability.

confirmed_no_change_needed.note: D1: already covered by TopicLexicon::ANCHORS['permisos'] (question-side) and unaffected by this sprint's salary-pattern change — a permisos question, not a salary one.
D1: no change. GuardrailService::SENSITIVE_PATTERNS already intercepts it in the disciplinary bucket, before the salary pre-classifier or the router ever runs — out of scope per spec §3.

correction01_statutory_escalation._description: Sprint 10b, Correction-01 (post-D1-bis regression, found on Pedram's eyes-on pass). D1-bis only proved the SMI/salario-mínimo pattern MATCHES (the rows above) and only re-ran the no-tables gold-eval profile downstream — it never checked the downstream OUTCOME for an employee who has a resolvable salary table and category, where `SalaryAnswerService::answer()` used to return OUTCOME_ANSWER with the employee's own category cell, a real but non-responsive figure. These rows pin the outcome contract directly: SMI/salario-mínimo questions must escalate `salary_coverage_gap` (sub_outcome `statutory_figure`) for EVERY employee profile, tables or not. Harness: Sprint10bCorrection01Test.php.

no_tables_profile.question: ¿ha subido el salario mínimo interprofesional este año?

with_tables_profile.question: ¿Cuál es el SMI este año?
with_tables_profile.note: THE regression case. Before Correction-01: OUTCOME_ANSWER with the employee's own category-cell figure — a real number, non-responsive to the statutory figure actually asked.

with_tables_profile.question: ¿ha subido el salario mínimo interprofesional este año?
¿Cuánto gano?
with_tables_profile.note: No-change control — an ORDINARY salary question for the SAME with-tables employee must still answer from the SQL row exactly as before. Proves the fix is narrow (SMI/salario-mínimo only), not a blanket new escalation on the whole salary path.
